column1: # TWO DEFECTS IN THE OpenEduCat PAYLOAD, both first-hand and both decision-relevant:

#    included at the bottom as well".  In 8 241 B the string "GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE"
#    occurs ZERO times; the file ends mid-LGPL, at "...for the Library."  The operative grant
#    is LGPL-3.0; a reader relying on the file's own claim would be citing enclosed terms that
#    are not enclosed.
